turns.customer: If I bring my dog to daycare 5 days a week, is the unlimited membership better than buying 20-day packs?
blocks:
At five daycare days a week, the **$540/month unlimited membership looks like the better value** than a single 20-day pack at $650, assuming you’ll use the membership regularly. A 20-day pack covers 20 visits, so it may not cover every weekday in a longer month.

| Option | Listed price | Basis |
|---|---:|---|
| Unlimited membership | $540 | Per month; the rate sheet says the effective rate can be as low as $18/day, depending on use. |
| 20-day pack | $650 | One prepaid pack for one dog; covers 20 daycare days. |

The pack is prepaid, non-refundable, and can’t be combined with other discounts. These are listed prices, not confirmation of availability.
